info.name: LogiFlow — Complete API Collection
info.description:
Full API collection for LogiFlow backend.

## Quick Start
1. Import both files: collection + environment
2. Select the **LogiFlow API** environment
3. Run **Register** → check email for OTP → run **Verify Email** → tokens auto-saved
4. All subsequent requests use `{{accessToken}}` automatically

## Base URL
`{{baseUrl}}` defaults to `http://localhost:3000/api/v1`
Change to your Render URL for production testing.

item.name: Verify Email (Step 2 — creates account, returns tokens)

request.description:
Step 2 of registration. Enter the 6-digit OTP from your email.
On success: user is created in DB, tokens are returned and saved to environment variables.
Requires email verification first (Step 2 above). Unverified accounts cannot log in.
Issues a new access token + refresh token pair. Old refresh token is revoked immediately (rotation).
Revokes the provided refresh token. Access token remains valid until its 15-minute expiry.
Requires authentication. Also invalidates ALL existing refresh tokens (forces re-login on all devices).
Opens Google consent screen. Must be opened in a browser — not testable via Postman. After consent, bKash redirects to /auth/google/callback and issues tokens.
Accepts multipart/form-data. Include 'avatar' file field for profile photo upload.
Valid roles: CUSTOMER, COURIER, HUB_MANAGER, OPERATIONS_MANAGER, ADMIN
Soft deletes the user (sets deletedAt). Blocked if user has active shipments or is the last admin.

Shipment must be AT_ORIGIN_HUB or AT_DESTINATION_HUB and currently at this hub.
